.oh-p1b-kicker{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}.oh-p1b-scene{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem;margin:0 0 1.35rem;padding:1.35rem 1.25rem 1.45rem;border:1px solid rgba(155,138,251,.14);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(165deg,rgba(14,22,48,.92),rgba(8,14,32,.96));box-shadow:0 18px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}.oh-p1b-title{margin:0;color:#fff;font-size:1.28rem;line-height:1.3;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.01em}.oh-p1b-caption{margin:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.5;max-width:42rem}.oh-p1b-opp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:1.1rem;align-items:stretch}.oh-p1b-opp-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.85rem;padding:1.1rem;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid rgba(155,138,251,.28);background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(28,36,72,.95),rgba(12,18,40,.98));box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.03),0 16px 36px rgba(91,33,182,.12)}.oh-p1b-opp-top{display:flex;gap:.85rem;align-items:center}.oh-p1b-thumb{width:72px;height:56px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid rgba(155,138,251,.25);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(91,33,182,.35),rgba(30,58,138,.45));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex:0 0 auto}.oh-p1b-hotel-mark{width:34px;height:28px;border:1.5px solid rgba(196,181,253,.85);border-bottom-width:3px;border-radius:3px 3px 0 0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;gap:3px;padding:5px 5px 8px;box-sizing:border-box;box-shadow:inset 0 -8px 0 rgba(155,138,251,.12)}.oh-p1b-hotel-win{background:rgba(196,181,253,.55);border-radius:1px;min-height:4px}.oh-p1b-dot{width:8px;height:8px;margin-top:.35rem;border-radius:99px;background:#9B8AFB;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(155,138,251,.15);flex:0 0 auto}.oh-p1b-branch-lines{position:relative;height:36px;margin:.1rem 0 .2rem}.oh-p1b-branch-hub{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0;width:10px;height:10px;margin-left:-5px;border-radius:99px;background:#9B8AFB;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(155,138,251,.15)}.oh-p1b-branch-fan{position:absolute;left:8%;right:8%;top:9px;height:24px;border-top:1.5px solid rgba(155,138,251,.35);border-radius:0 0 40% 40%;opacity:.9}.oh-p1b-path-ico{width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid rgba(155,138,251,.35);flex:0 0 auto;background:rgba(155,138,251,.08);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.oh-p1b-ico-sq{width:10px;height:10px;border:1.5px solid #9B8AFB;border-radius:3px}.oh-p1b-ico-op{width:10px;height:11px;border:1.5px solid #9B8AFB;border-radius:2px 2px 0 0}.oh-p1b-ico-bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;width:12px}.oh-p1b-ico-bar{height:1.5px;background:#9B8AFB;border-radius:1px}.oh-p1b-ico-bar-dim{height:1.5px;background:#9B8AFB;border-radius:1px;opacity:.45}.oh-p1b-ico-spin{width:11px;height:11px;border:1.5px solid #9B8AFB;border-radius:99px;border-left-color:transparent;transform:rotate(-45deg)}.oh-p1b-ico-cap{width:8px;height:12px;border:1.5px solid #9B8AFB;border-radius:1px}.oh-p1b-ico-ring{width:10px;height:10px;border:1.5px dashed #9B8AFB;border-radius:99px}.oh-p1b-opp-name{margin:0;color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;font-weight:650}.oh-p1b-opp-meta{margin:.2rem 0 0;color:rgba(183,196,255,.7);font-size:.78rem}.oh-p1b-meta-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.55rem}.oh-p1b-meta-item{display:flex;gap:.55rem;align-items:flex-start;padding:.65rem .7rem;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(8,14,32,.55)}.oh-p1b-meta-text{margin:0;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);font-size:.82rem;line-height:1.35;font-weight:500}.oh-p1b-branch{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.7rem;padding:.35rem .1rem}.oh-p1b-paths{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:.55rem}.oh-p1b-path{display:flex;gap:.55rem;align-items:center;padding:.7rem .75rem;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid rgba(155,138,251,.18);background:rgba(13,21,48,.72)}.oh-p1b-path-label{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);font-size:.84rem;font-weight:550;line-height:1.25}@media screen and (max-width:991px){.oh-p1b-opp{grid-template-columns:1fr}.oh-p1b-paths{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media screen and (max-width:767px){.oh-p1b-scene{padding:1.1rem 1rem 1.2rem}.oh-p1b-meta-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.oh-p1b-paths{grid-template-columns:1fr}.oh-p1b-title{font-size:1.12rem}}
